exposure: Echocardiographic parameters of right ventricular overload, pulmonary hypertension, and systemic steal
Mediolateral diameter of the straight or falcine sinus at its shortest section
outcome: Severe high output heart failure (HOHF) at birth
cohort: 40 newborns with Vein of Galen Aneurysmal Malformation (VGAM) admitted to Gaslini Children's Hospital between 2009 and 2022.
finding: Fetal cardiothoracic ratio, specific echocardiographic and neuroradiologic parameters were associated with severe HOHF at birth, while early endovascular treatment and specialized intensive care management contributed to an 82.5% survival rate at discharge.
